blocks.text: The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Beeswax puck is not ticked. Tin of balm, 1 oz is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.
The later bill is $52.89 every month.
The first parcel is forty four dollars and five cents. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.

product.description: The balm sits in a small tin, one ounce.
product.name: Tin of balm, 1 oz

trick.evidence_text: The lower figure is only the first parcel. Later bills are $52.89 every month.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
